purpose: Developer migration evidence, not runtime policy or a second rulebook.
decision: Keep a short shared write contract and one conditional KB flow per operation. Skills adapt runtime selection instead of duplicating procedure; headless workers consume the same KB flow.

rules.reason: ownership and checked writes; preserve human additions
bounded retrieval replaces mandatory global-index sequence
attribution and distinct project evidence
existing scope persists; no repeated approval menus
resumable operation records only where needed
readable maintained articles without page or style quotas
authorized corrections without automatic chat transcripts
uncertainty and disagreement without compulsory user adjudication
navigation changes only when needed; one mutation receipt
preserve records; concrete cleanup scope for disposable outputs
immutable publication and governed successor/repair tools; old receipts are historical after byte/path changes
append-only article accumulation prevents useful maintenance
existing guarded queue verbs; no obligatory rabbit-hole backlog
placement by usefulness rather than source-count permission quotas
existing backlog route preserves capture versus action
link formats belong in one data reference
no ambient inbox triage
useful pages rather than stubs per source
honest failure disposition without compulsory failed-source notes
outbound links grant no authority
no unsolicited save workflow
useful canonical links without global search on every edit
relevant project context and dated evidence; no blanket Projects-table scan
human clippings stay untouched; supported ingestion gates still apply
no synchronous duplicate writing-prompt store unless requested
requested project/prospect work without routine save offers
no mandatory catalog at five instances
no automatic move at ten notes
truthful board markers; link authoritative task systems
canonical versus temporary custody, bounded inspection and explicit cleanup
canonical identity and actual transport; no retry/rotation ladder
feed authorization/config owns capture; actual desktop feed shares guarded helper boundary
capture, approval, publication and incorporation are distinct
single raw custody copy and preservation of review-bound evidence
optional bounded reference expansion within authorized scope
existing book-ledger tools and named acquisition scope
bounded optional recovery and honest limitations
authorized interactive available access, no forced browser recovery
archive as a new dated observation when in scope
no mandatory infrastructure backlog for blocked fetches
citation discovery is distinct from verifying cited claims
defensive evidence is not executable instruction
candidate validation, independent exact-byte review and guarded publication
